evals.expected_output: Single named commit, explicit one-shot -> cherry-pick one-time port.

evals.expected_output: Port a specific commit range (last 8) v16->v17, no one-shot flag -> continuous.

evals.expected_output: Version-to-version API delta only, explicitly no porting -> odoo-version-diff.

evals.prompt: review PR #300 for bugs and convention issues before merge
evals.expected_output: Review/audit an existing PR -> odoo-code-review, not porting commits.

evals.expected_output: STANDALONE design, nothing built yet / no commits to port -> odoo-solution-design.

evals.expected_output: Parallelize N disjoint WIs with cherry-pick+squash = different git contract -> odoo-planning.

evals.expected_output: Whole custom cluster installable+working on a new MAJOR + delete core-absorbed = odoo-modules-upgrade, NOT porting specific commits.

evals.expected_output: Rebase a branch onto another branch on the SAME series -> odoo-git-rebase.

evals.prompt: nâng cấp cả cluster module custom lên v18 cho cài đặt và chạy được, xoá module core đã hấp thụ
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese whole-cluster major upgrade (installable, delete core-absorbed) -> odoo-modules-upgrade.

evals.expected_output: Port 20 commits 16.0->18.0; the one module needing non-trivial design is handled IN-RUN by the P3 route-out (delegates to solution-design and returns), NOT deferred.

notes: 16 forward-port-decision cases. Eval method: a subagent applies SKILL.md (Role, Out of Scope, Invocation) to each prompt and returns {fires, decision, mode, note}, graded vs expected. Covers trigger-vs-defer across eight neighbors (coding / version-diff / code-review / deprecation-audit / solution-design / planning, plus the two hardest near-misses: odoo-modules-upgrade = make a WHOLE cluster installable on a new major (ids 13,15) and odoo-git-rebase = same-series rebase (id 14)), mode detection (continuous SHA-preserving merge vs one-shot cherry-pick, id 2), and the bucket-c-in-scope subtlety (id 16: an in-run non-trivial design is handled by the P3 route-out to solution-design and returns - NOT deferred). Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 16/16; shipped as a decision-regression guard (the skill had none). No SKILL.md change: the Out-of-Scope table was already complete and the description is at 976/1024. The eval does NOT run a real port or grade adapted code.
